Human-plus-LLM collaboration compared with LLM-alone answering of the same test questions

links.outcome: Pediatric asthma-management test scores after ChatGPT training and assisted testing
links.effect: Five-minute ChatGPT training plus assisted testing improved scores by approximately 20 points. The comparison bundled training with ChatGPT access, so the independent training effect was not isolated.
links.quote: In the intervention group, however, we found that using ChatGPT significantly and substantially improved doctors' asthma management abilities in the short term (by approximately 20 points) and increased their satisfaction with answering questions.

unlisted_practices: Clinician–ChatGPT collaboration rather than ChatGPT-only answers for pediatric asthma knowledge questions.
